test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The country is witnessing a severe locust outbreak in Rajasthan and Gujarat.

options.text: A severe locust outbreak in Rajasthan and Gujarat is being witnessed by the country.
A severe locust outbreak in the country is being witnessed by Rajasthan and Gujarat.
A severe locust outbreak in Rajasthan and Gujarat is witnessing the country.
A severe locust outbreak in Rajasthan and Gujarat has been witnessed by the country.

solution:
The correct answer is **"A severe locust outbreak in Rajasthan and Gujarat is being witnessed by the country."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The construction of Active Voice here is –

 **Subject + am / is / are + Verb (+ing) + Object**

 The construction of Passive Voice here is –

 **Subject1 + am / is / are + being + Verb3 + (by +agent)**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *A severe locust outbreak in Rajasthan and Gujarat is being witnessed by the country..*
